ACTION: Create /tmp/validate_ridership/profile.py (read-only profile of both parquets; kept outside ridership/ so nothing in the packet folder changes). Text:
```python
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import polars as pl

for year in ("2025", "2026"):
    p = Path(f"data/trips_{year}q3.parquet")
    print(f"===== {p}  sha256={hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()[:16]}")
    lf = pl.scan_parquet(p)
    print(lf.collect_schema())
    print(lf.select(
        pl.len().alias("rows"),
        pl.col("trip_id").null_count().alias("null_trip_id"),
        pl.col("trip_id").n_unique().alias("unique_trip_id"),
        pl.col("district").null_count().alias("null_district"),
        pl.col("started_at").min().alias("first_start"),
        pl.col("started_at").max().alias("last_start"),
    ).collect())
    # raw rows vs distinct trip_ids per district, including districts outside the five the script keeps
    print(lf.group_by("district").agg(
        pl.len().alias("raw_rows"), pl.col("trip_id").n_unique().alias("unique_ids")
    ).sort("district").collect())
    n = lf.select(pl.len()).collect().item()
    print("fully duplicated rows:", n - lf.unique().select(pl.len()).collect().item())
    day = pl.col("started_at").dt.date().alias("day")
    daily = lf.group_by(day).agg(pl.len().alias("rides")).sort("day")
    print("first days:\n", daily.head(5).collect())
    print("last days:\n", daily.tail(10).collect())
```
